# Smooth Birth Apothecary
> Traditional East Asian herbal tinctures formulated by licensed acupuncturist and certified herbalist Simba Eun-Hye Shim, L.Ac.

## Overview
Smooth Birth Apothecary offers targeted, clinical-grade botanical tinctures supporting pregnant and birthing families across four key phases:
1. Pregnancy Support (Swell Away, Deep Rest 1, Deep Rest 2, Cool Center)
2. Birth Prep (Getting Ready, Boost Up)
3. Labor Support (More Oomph, High Baby, Turn Around)
4. Postpartum Recovery (Abundant Flow)

## Founder
Formulated by Simba Eun-Hye Shim, L.Ac., licensed acupuncturist and certified Chinese herbalist with a Master of Acupuncture and Chinese Herbal Medicine from Southwest Acupuncture College in Boulder. Practicing at Boulder Birth and Holistic Health.

## Wholesale for Birth Professionals
Direct wholesale ordering for midwives, doulas, birth centers, and obstetric clinics is available through the Wholesale Portal at https://smoothbirth.com/wholesale.html.
